name: LAB-Bench
intro: LAB-Bench 是面向实际生物学研究能力的 2,457 题基准，涵盖 8 个大类、30 个子任务。序列和数据库问答主要程序生成，其余文献、补充材料、图表、实验方案和克隆场景由作者及生物学专家编写并审核。
build_method: 程序生成与生物学专家编写
modality: 文本, 图像, 生物序列
eval_feature: 实际科研任务, 专家基线
intro_en: LAB-Bench is a 2,457-question benchmark of practical biology-research capabilities across eight broad categories and 30 subtasks. Sequence and database QA are mainly programmatic; literature, supplement, figure, table, protocol, and cloning tasks are authored and reviewed by the paper's authors and biology experts.
drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2407.10362v3, especially the benchmark construction and Appendix C, plus official futurehouse/lab-bench dataset snapshot 5c77cec. The diagram separates the exact programmatic branch—750 SeqQA questions across 15 subtasks and 650 DbQA questions across ten subtasks—from the expert-authored branch: LitQA2 248, SuppQA 102, FigQA 226, TableQA 305, ProtocolQA 135, and CloningScenarios 41. Model suggestions are optional inspiration only and remain subject to expert correction. Calibration closely reviews each author's first 5–10 questions, followed by ongoing review and revision. The final 2,457 questions carry contamination canaries and an approximately 80/20 public/private split per subtask. Models run three no-tool zero-shot-chain-of-thought trials with an insufficient-information option; accuracy, precision, and coverage are reported. The separate PhD-researcher baseline may use research tools but no AI tools.
